Her figure is divided into 5 horizontal bands by 4 hazy transition zones centred about 19% of the way down her figure from the top, about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 71% of the way down her figure from the top and about 89% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries Kandinsky style circles, triangles and sweeping lines rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Klimt style spirals and mosaic ornament rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Region 4 is the band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Lichtenstein style Ben-Day dots and thick outlines rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Region 5 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries thick impasto oil paint with heavy palette-knife ridges rendered only in deep indigo, ivory white and gold. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
